The park is managed by the New Zealand Department of Conservation.


== Geography ==
The park covers 111,021 hectares (274,340 acres) of the Raukūmara Range and surrounding area, including Mount Hikurangi and the Mōtū River.


== History ==
The park was established in 1979.
